title: Preschool Director
description: Salary: $50,000–$60,000, depending on experience. Trinity Christian Academy is seeking a dedicated and experienced Preschool Director to lead its early childhood education program: a strong leader with a passion for nurturing young minds and building a vibrant Christian foundation for students. The Director oversees daily preschool operations and state licensing compliance, develops an age-appropriate curriculum aligned with the school's mission, hires, trains and supervises teaching staff, communicates with families, manages the preschool budget, and coordinates special events. Requirements: Bachelor's or Associate's degree in Early Childhood Education, Child Development or a related field; 1–2 years of early childhood administration experience; commitment to Christian education principles; knowledge of state licensing requirements; budget and staff management experience; CPR and First Aid certification.
